text:
mira: Heads up — since yesterday's canary we see ~2x reconnect billing spikes from SSE clients flagged by console diagnostics. The trigger looks like diagnostic-sample-rate=1.0 for routes with resume enabled. Anyone else seeing this?
ajay: Yup saw same in eu cluster. Console shows sample-rate override for sessions that hit a replay path. Not sure why we turned full sampling on for canary.
leo: @mira can you paste the console filter you used? I want to see the exact bucket.
mira: ```
service:streaming
route:/v1/stream
diagnostics.sample_rate:1.0
event:reconnect
```
samir: That filter matches. I think recent rollouts to enable detailed reconnect traces flipped a feature-flag that sets sample_rate=1 for tenant=canary. It should be 0.01.
ajay: If we over-sample reconnects we'll double-charge traces and it skews quota backpressure heuristics. Also impacts sticky-routing decisions.
mira: Proposed immediate fix: flip flag to 0.01 for canary and prune existing traces. Longer-term: add circuit-breaker so diag-sampling scales with reconnect rate and tenant quota. Thoughts?
leo: Agree. Also console UX: the sampling toggle isn't exposed in the rollout page. We should surface effective sample rate per route and per tenant and a 'simulated cost delta' when flipping.
samir: I can patch the feature flag tomorrow morning. Can we hotfix the console to show a prominent warning when sample_rate>0.1 on streaming endpoints?
ajay: We need to audit whether resume-enabled routes default to higher kv-cache diagnostic levels. Maybe a migration set wrong default.
mira: Action items: @samir flip flag + PR, @leo prototype console warning + cost delta card, @ajay audit resume defaults. I'll create a short incident ticket for billing ops to expect a blip. :warning: 
samir: On it. I'll include a small script to backfill sample-rate tag on traces and drop high-fidelity logs older than 24h to save storage.
leo: UX sketch: show current sample_rate, projected tokens/day, estimated $ impact over 24h. Place behind 'advanced' but link during rollouts.
ajay: If we add circuit-breaker, let's ensure it considers 'in-flight token window' to avoid oscillation. I'll file an RFC.
mira: Thanks. If anyone spots a tenant with sustained reconnect >100/s, DM me. I'll pause canary if needed.
ops-bot: deploy notice: feature-flag change scheduled by samir — will broadcast once PR merges.
